In {{aniseries|RS}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] travels to the [[Hoenn]] [[region]] with {{AP|Pikachu}}, meeting new {{AP|friends}} in siblings {{an|May}} and [[Max]] and reuniting with {{an|Brock}}. Ash aims to collect eight [[Badge|Gym Badges]] to enter the [[Hoenn League]], while May decides to instead focus on [[Pokémon Contest]]s as a [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. Together, they face many challenges and threats, including the villainous [[Team Aqua]] and [[Team Magma]], who plan to awaken Hoenn's [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{OBP|Kyogre and Groudon|Ruby and Sapphire series}}.

Following the [[Ever Grande Conference]] for Ash and the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]] for May, the group of friends reunites in [[Kanto]], where Ash learns of a new kind of challenge: the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}, a set of seven [[Battle facility|battle facilities]] manned by extremely powerful Trainers known as [[Frontier Brain]]s, spread out all across the Kanto region. With this new and intriguing challenge ahead of him, Ash sets on a new journey through Kanto alongside his friends to earn all seven [[Symbol|Frontier Symbols]], with May getting another shot at her dream of becoming a [[Top Coordinator]] by competing in Kanto's Pokémon Contests.

Simultaneously, [[Pokémon Chronicles]] features the adventures of Ash's former [[rival]]s and traveling companions, showcasing how their lives move on outside of meeting up or traveling with him.
